mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS line_id,h.id AS source_id,h.shipment_no AS source_no,h.company_id,o.customer_id AS partner_id, h.warehouse_id,l.sku_id,l.batch_no,l.shipped_qty AS quantity,l.returned_qty,l.posted_amount,l.currency FROM sal_shipment_line l JOIN sal_shipment h ON h.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND h.id=l.shipment_id JOIN sal_order o ON o.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND o.id=h.order_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.id=#{lineId} FOR UPDATE OF l
SELECT FROM sal_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sal_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND command_id=#{commandId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sal_shipment_line SET returned_qty=returned_qty+#{quantity} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{sourceLineId} AND #{quantity}>0 AND returned_qty+#{quantity} <= shipped_qty
UPDATE sal_return SET state=#{next},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{r.tenantId} AND id=#{r.id} AND version=#{r.version} AND state=#{r.state}
UPDATE sal_return SET amount=#{amount} WHERE tenant_id=#{r.tenantId} AND id=#{r.id}
